scripts.contracts:export: uv run --frozen --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py packages/contracts/openapi.json
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/schema.ts
scripts.dev: pnpm run infra:up && pnpm run config:check && pnpm --parallel --filter @feedbackos/api --filter @feedbackos/web run dev
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:current: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini current
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check --config apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run typecheck:contracts && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:api: test ! -d tests/api || uv run --project apps/api pytest -c apps/api/pyproject.toml tests/api
